title: One-one but not onto · onto but not one-one
back: Left: no two arrows share an image, but one element is left out. Right: every element is hit, but two arrows share an image.

title: Reflexive relation
legend: A = the set on which R is defined
back: Every element is related to itself. One missing $(a,a)$ is enough to say "not reflexive".

title: Symmetric relation
back: Swap test. To disprove, show one pair whose reverse is not in $R$.

title: Transitive relation
back: Chain test. If there is no chain at all to test, the relation is transitive.

title: Equivalence relation
back: Prove all three, each with its own line and conclusion: 1 mark each in a 3-marker.

title: Equivalence class of a
back: The classes split $A$ into parts that do not overlap. For "$a-b$ divisible by 5" on $\mathbb Z$ there are 5 classes: $[0],[1],[2],[3],[4]$.

title: One-one (injective)
back: Different inputs give different outputs. $x^2$ on $\mathbb R$ fails: $f(1)=f(-1)$.

title: Onto (surjective)
back: Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, and check that $x$ is in the domain for every $y$ in the codomain.

title: Number of relations from A to B
legend: m = number of elements in A
n = number of elements in B
back: A relation is a subset of $A\times B$, which has $mn$ pairs. On one set with $n$ elements: $2^{n^2}$.

title: Number of functions from A to B
legend: m = number of elements in A (domain)
n = number of elements in B
back: Each of the $m$ inputs chooses one of $n$ outputs. One-one functions: $n(n-1)\cdots(n-m+1)$; bijections of a set with $m$ elements: $m!$.
